title: MineGPT+
description: This plugin allows you to communicate with ChatGPT with a simple command.
body:
**💬 /MineGPT Command**
==================

Thanks to the /MineGPT command, you can directly chat with ChatGPT inside your Minecraft server!
Simply add your OpenAI API key to the config.yml file, and you’ll be able to send requests to ChatGPT — it will respond right in-game.


**⚙️ Setup**
========
1. Open the config.yml file generated by the plugin.
2. Add your API key in the following section:
   openai:
     api-key: "your_api_key_here"
3. Restart your server.
4. Use the command:
   /MineGPT <your message>


**⚠️ Common Errors**
================
- HTTP 401 → Invalid or missing API key
- HTTP 429 → Too many requests (rate limit exceeded)
- Other codes → Check your API provider or network configuration


**💡 Tip**
======
You can use any API compatible with OpenAI.
If you encounter issues, try testing your key on the OpenAI Playground:
https://platform.openai.com/playground


**🔗 Useful Links**
===============
